speaker: (a churchwarden)
text: The dish is for the parish. The box is beside it, if a man has his own.

speaker: (a churchwarden)
text: Two shillings. God yield it you.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He heard you. He is not going to answer, and that is the whole of it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: No name. Two shillings is the sum. I am watching, Master Shakespeare, and I have seen no show.
